lessons.finding: The neutral-named public.pandora_projects compatibility view still depended on retired ProjectOS storage, so using it for Operations authorization preserved a retired execution dependency.
lessons.fix: Use an explicit service-role-only private.pandora_ops_project_bindings registry with evidence references. Missing or revoked bindings fail closed across initialize, claim, dispatch, and owner admission; browser/owner calls cannot create bindings.
lessons.verifiedBy: Final PR #728 source at 50dd5508bded271bda446dd23991a5e9d82065f7 plus Operations Room runtime and Node 24 exact-head CI

lessons.finding: Concurrent shared-account writers corrupted the PR branch by replacing the complete DB test with placeholder/partial content.
lessons.fix: Freeze the exact feature branch with a temporary no-bypass ruleset, prepare detached recovery commits, assign one exclusive recovery owner, verify blob/tree identity, remove only the temporary freeze, then perform one non-force fast-forward.
lessons.verifiedBy: Operations Room issue #714 comments 5833613944, 5833642589, 5833978572, 5834067741 and final head provider readback

lessons.finding: JavaScript String.replace replacement syntax collapsed intended PostgreSQL $$ function delimiters to a single $, causing migration replay failures across Operations Room, Node24, and Engineering CI.
lessons.fix: Use function-valued replacements for literal $$ delimiters, verify the published migration bytes contain the two-character delimiter, then rerun exact-head CI.
lessons.verifiedBy: Failed head df80c6c2ee06479999c53ed5a4c29d991647bcd8 followed by corrected head 50dd5508bded271bda446dd23991a5e9d82065f7 and green migration replay

lessons.finding: The primary independent Gemini reviewer returned provider HTTP 503 high demand and produced no verdict.
lessons.fix: Treat provider unavailability as no review result and use the approved Worker E fallback model on the same exact diff. Preserve the 503 as provider evidence rather than retrying blindly.
lessons.verifiedBy: Worker E fallback gemini-3.1-flash-lite response UIa2at-sGZ6pvr0PrMut-Ao, exact head 50dd5508bded271bda446dd23991a5e9d82065f7, PASS with zero findings

lessons.finding: An idempotent claim alone does not prevent two coordinators from delivering the same worker request.
lessons.fix: Persist a one-sender dispatch transition; require canSend=true and exact task/worker/generation ACK. Unknown delivery outcomes retain resource claims for reconciliation.
lessons.verifiedBy: Operations Room runtime PostgreSQL separate-session race workflow 36148045372

lessons.finding: Different worker names do not establish an independent verifier.
lessons.fix: Require a separately registered principal and an existing canonical exact-source verification PASS bound to the task requirements.
lessons.verifiedBy: Same-principal rejection and canonical PASS consumption tests plus separate Worker E review

lessons.finding: Including machine-owned status cells in a spreadsheet input hash breaks the next legitimate sync.
lessons.fix: Hash owner inputs plus row/header identity; restrict machine updates to designated columns using literal RAW values.
lessons.verifiedBy: Status-refresh, owner-edit, malformed-row and formula rejection tests
